I’m just letting KiA know that I am meeting with my MP on July 10th to talk about GG’s treatment (or mistreatment) in the media and affects/dangers it has created for supporters.

While I am doing my best to collect relevant data for the meeting (Making use of Deep Freeze, GG wiki etc) I figured I would have a post here in case I need to find evidence I know is around but can’t find myself, so at some point I may shout out for help on getting a particular piece of evidence.

Tweet I made about it: http://twitter.com/JodisWelch/status/608682351170830336

I have a screenshot of their reply e-mail offering an invite to talk (With some info redacted) if needed for verification.

I’m hiding the identity of the MP for the moment as I know how bad Anti-GG can be for attacking people. It’s also protecting me for the moment as it would make it obvious where I live. I will say that they are Left Leaning (If not outright Left Wing) which is normally the case in my part of the country, just to nix any thought opposition have that we are Right Wing reactionary’s who only talk to RW talking heads (I personally do not identify with ether the Left or the Right).

Jodis Welch is obviously not my real name ether in an attempt to protect myself from potential threat of Anti-GG. I have had two meetings with management at my work over this appointment with my MP and what is being discussed and they have given me a positive response and freedom to go ahead with the meeting and assurances that if they start getting calls about me, accusing me of being all horrible things under the sun, that they will likely be ignored or if crossing a line, informing the authorities.

What this is NOT! Before anyone gets too excited, at this point I am only having a conversation about GG to my MP. It will not immediately start any sort of public inquiry or hearing or enacting any legislation!

At the very least we will have an MP with a sympathetic ear and that might be all we get, which to be fair is better than what we have at the moment.

If it does lead to say, an All Party Early Day Motion declaring “GamerGate is not a hate movement”, well that would be a big win but I’m not thinking that far ahead at this stage. I am curious to the advice/suggestions my MP has at the meeting’s end.

This will also be more UK focused given that MP’s generally only deal with matters within the UK. I’ll certainly be bringing up incidents relating to GG from around the world in order to give context (I mentioned to them the bomb threat called in on GGinDC that the FBI deemed credible) but I will mostly have to focus on UK issues (The Guardian do make that easy!).

Thanks ahead of time for any help I call for.
